# Bio Sites

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 14 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Link-in-bio marketing: monochrome Clarkson surface on a black hero collage, 40px-radius nav pills and an 80px black CTA pill that inverts to white on hover, slate persona cards in a moving carousel, giant 70px marquee links, and a 50px-radius claim field on the signed-out editor.

Captured 2026-11-11, signed out (every captured surface is public; the editor redirects to a claim screen that was measured but never submitted, and no account was created). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Bio Sites' public site — for building monochrome, pill-driven link-in-bio marketing surfaces in the style of the real thing. It was read from **biosites.com** on **2026-11-11**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844: the single-page marketing site and `/editor`, which redirects to the signed-out claim-username screen (`/editor#/create`), plus the mobile captures of both.

Bio Sites is worth a capture because it is a current reference for the monochrome link-in-bio surface (Squarespace's free Bio Sites product): a black body under white sections and a black hero collage, one inversion recipe — white pills that go black, a black CTA that goes white — repeated from the 40px nav pills to the 80px hero CTA, everything in Clarkson at weights 400/500 from 12px nav caps to 70px marquee links, the only hue a `#4f566f` slate on the moving persona cards, and the signed-out claim flow reduced to one 652 x 102 pill: prefix, username field, circular arrow submit. The bundle declares no design-token custom properties at all, so every token here is a measurement, not a variable resolution.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Readings past a masked bot signal.** The committed screenshots and readings were taken with `navigator.webdriver` masked, the flag bot checks read to spot automation. The capture scripts no longer mask it (not run since), so a recapture may record a walled route as a boundary instead of a reading.
- **One painted theme.** Every captured route paints light; no dark variant is declared anywhere, so the semantic set is emitted under `light` and the `dark` set is empty.
- **Every token is a measurement.** The stylesheets declare no design-token custom properties; `core.color.*` names the distinct computed values found across components and each `light.*` leaf's `$extensions.source` says which component/state it was read from. There is no variable layer to cross-check against.
- **`light.link` is muted, not an accent.** Nav and footer links carry their own computed colour (black on the nav pills, `#6a6a6a` in the footer hub, `#9c9c9c` on claim legal); there is no coloured link style on the public surface.
- **`component.*` tokens are measured**, not site variables.
- **The browser's focus ring.** Keyboard focus draws Chromium's default `auto` outline (`rgb(0,95,204)`), not a designed ring — `light.focus` records it as measured on `claim-login`/`claim-legal`.
- **Moving-marquee states.** `card-cta` default/hover/pressed read whichever card the carousel had in view; hover is CDP-forced because a pointer can never hold the moving card still.
- **Quantised screenshots.** `screenshots/` are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from tokens or the raw JSON.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do ground white sections on the black body.** The page is `#000000` end to end; the hero collage and marquee bands are black inside it, the content sections white over it. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
2. **Do use one CTA recipe: invert.** Every pill flips fill and text on hover and press — white pills go black (`nav-signup`, `nav-login`), the black 80px CTA goes white with a `#e6e6e6` hairline. See [cta-default](components/crops/cta-default.png) and [cta-hover](components/crops/cta-hover.png).
3. **Do set everything in Clarkson.** One family carries 12px/500 nav caps, 21px/400 body and the 70px/500 marquee — weight and tracking, not family changes, do the hierarchy. See [section-nav-link-default](components/crops/section-nav-link-default.png).
4. **Do pill the corners at the control's own scale.** Nav pills 40px radius on 40px height, the CTA 46px on 80px, the claim shell 50px on 102px — full-round ends, not a fixed radius step. See [claim-field-wrap-default](components/crops/claim-field-wrap-default.png).
5. **Don't invent a dark theme or a colour accent.** The bundle declares no dark variant and the palette is monochrome; the only hue is `#4f566f` slate on the persona cards (plus the browser's `#005fcc` focus ring). See [persona-card-default](components/crops/persona-card-default.png).
6. **Don't treat the FAQ as an accordion.** It is a static `<dl>`; answers always paint. See [faq-item-default](components/crops/faq-item-default.png).
7. **Don't expect a coloured link.** Links are ink or muted grey — `#6a6a6a` in the footer hub, `#9c9c9c` on claim legal — never an accent colour; the accent is always a pill fill, never a text colour. See [footer-link-default](components/crops/footer-link-default.png).
8. **Don't hold still for the carousel.** The persona-card strip never stops; `card-cta` states are CDP-forced readings of whichever card was in view. See [card-cta-hover](components/crops/card-cta-hover.png).
